# Synthetic vehicle review; metadata only

VEHICLE-002 Compare body/cabin proportions, wing height, wheels and plow with the original reference before visual acceptance.
VEHICLE-003 Formal PASS0/Model Contract acceptance must be established separately from metadata presence.

No Blender scene or real images are included. This example requires no engine.
The user's acceptance of visual improvement after patch A remains unchanged.
